newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Rexrodt says economic recovery intact.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Rexrodt says economic recovery intact.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Thursday that the recovery of Europe's largest economy would continue this year and that the government saw no reason to change its forecast for economic growth.

"We are standing by our forecast of 2.5 percent economic growth," Rexrodt told parliament during a debate on the government's annual economic report. "The German economy has been back on the growth track since the spring of 1996. All indications show that this will continue in 1997."
